h: One reportedly killed as thugs attack a candidate's convoy linked to Kwankwaso's party
p: Reports say hoodlums attacked the convoy of a candidate from the party of Rabiu Kwankwaso, leaving one person dead. Details of the location and any arrests have not been confirmed.
more: Parties have been urged to keep campaigns peaceful.
Police are yet to issue a statement.
